articles.title: TikTok bans Musk documentary account
articles.essence: Just ahead of the wider release of Alex Gibney's Musk documentary, TikTok has banned the film's social media account from its platform. TikTok did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
articles.full_body: Just ahead of the wider release of Alex Gibney's Musk documentary, TikTok has banned the film's social media account from its platform. TikTok did not immediately respond to a request for comment. sentences: Just ahead of the wider release of Alex Gibney's Musk documentary, TikTok has banned the film's social media account from its platform.
TikTok did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
According to The Hollywood Reporter, the film's distributor, Bleecker Street, was informed Friday afternoon that a "permanent suspension" was imminent.

articles.title: Mercedes-AMG’s first ground-up SUV is a 1,150hp electric beast
articles.essence: Earlier this year, Mercedes' AMG performance brand grabbed our attention with the GT four-door coupe, a souped-up sports sedan with three axial flux motors delivering over 1,150 horsepower. Well, now meet its beefier cousin, the 2028 Mercedes-AMG GT SUV, an equally powerful, ultra-fast-charging electric people-hauler.

articles.title: Elon Musk settles lawsuits over $1 million voter giveaway
articles.essence: In 2024, Elon Musk promised to give away $1 million a day to a randomly selected registered voter in a swing state. That prompted legal challenges, raised questions about its legality, and drew lawsuits from two Arizona residents claiming the lottery was a fraud.

articles.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
articles.essence: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI.
